source_equivalence: Release preparation changes metadata, screenshots, workflow capture scopes and tests only. App, TransitCore and project source remain identical to the valid uploaded build.

validation.coverage: Four native light tests cover continuous map camera transitions, Reduce Motion, route stop focus and in-app station walking. Two dark tests and appearance switching also pass.
Five of six light journey tests and all three dark tests passed, including remaining journey duration, confirmed onboard plate, real Neihu choices and waiting/tracking/transfer flows.
validation.failure_review: The live search/compare test retained an option that became closed during late service. The failure screenshot shows the correct disabled closed-service option. Test preparation now waits for confirmed choices; this exact search/compare case was not rerun. No unavailable option was forced selectable.

validation.coverage: Core tests and Debug/Release compilation passed. Real live 3D bus, destination/itinerary/onboard and in-app walking screenshot flows passed.
validation.failure_review: The new home route-control tap did not trigger the route sheet. The capture test now identifies the exact control and uses the same 0.15-second press verified by the native control tests.

validation.coverage: Core tests and Debug/Release compilation passed. The exact new home route control opens search; the route keypad finds Blue 27 and opens its route map.

store_gallery.review: Every composed image was visually inspected. Native app pixels and displayed values are unchanged. Original captures and their hashes are preserved.
store_gallery.excluded_capture: The waiting screenshot was omitted because the simulator passenger was at City Hall while the selected manual departure was Neihu. Beginning navigation correctly recalculated a long approach from the passenger GPS; that setup is unsuitable for marketing.
store_gallery.live_data: Public bus GPS and arrival feeds are real. Passenger position is simulated. Station-walking capture uses a controlled passenger/stop setup; it does not inject bus plates or ETAs.

limits: Simulator functional and camera checks do not measure physical-device frame rates or observed arrival accuracy.
Official next-arrival estimates are not tied to a particular vehicle plate. Unsupported individual-vehicle times remain pending confirmation.
